items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Dizzy Gillespie's influence and collaborations with others (Charlie Parker, Earl Hines) but does not mention any personal interaction or relationship with Dizzy himself.

ctx.x: Yeah. Dizzy said to me one time that, you know, you listen -- you keep listening to everybody, and you keep playing what you like, what you heard that you like, and you keep playing it. And suddenly you find that, coming out of this foundation, is something that you didn't ever hear before, which is you.
